[{"node": "menu_content107", "element": "menu_content", "data": {"label": "Payments", "key": "payments_menu_content", "id": "payments_menu_content", "name": "payments_menu_content"}, "elements": [{"node": "markdown101", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Cash register", "key": "md_cash_register", "id": "cash-register", "name": "md_cash_register", "value": "# Cash register

Each cashier works with **their own register**. Press the bank icon at the top:

1. **Open** it with the float in the drawer.
2. See the **live shift report**: sales, checks, taxes, voids and the expected amount per payment method.
3. At the end of the shift, **count the drawer**. Ren shows the difference per method and closes the register in ERPNext.
"}}, {"node": "markdown102", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Charging an order", "key": "md_charging_an_order", "id": "charging-an-order", "name": "md_charging_an_order", "value": "# Charging an order

Press **Pay**. The total comes from ERPNext exactly as it will be invoiced. Choose the payment method, enter the amount (cash suggestions included) and **Charge**. Only cash can be overpaid; the change is shown in large numbers. Taking payments is a role permission.
"}}, {"node": "markdown103", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Tips", "key": "md_tips", "id": "tips", "name": "md_tips", "value": "# Tips

When a tips account is set in the POS Profile, the payment screen shows suggested percentages (for example 18, 20 and 22%) and a custom amount. The tip is recorded on the invoice, on the configured liability account, together with the server who took the order.
"}}, {"node": "markdown104", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Split checks", "key": "md_split_checks", "id": "split-checks", "name": "md_split_checks", "value": "# Split checks

- **Split evenly**: choose the number of guests; each one pays their share with the method they want.
- **By items**: use **Divide** to move items to a separate order and charge each order.
"}}, {"node": "markdown105", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Card readers (Stripe Terminal)", "key": "md_card_readers_stripe_terminal", "id": "card-readers-stripe-terminal", "name": "md_card_readers_stripe_terminal", "value": "# Card readers (Stripe Terminal)

With card readers configured, choosing their payment method shows **Charge on reader**. The amount appears on the reader; the customer taps or inserts the card and the screen confirms. An approved charge is never lost: if the screen is closed, it comes back when you reopen the payment.
"}}, {"node": "markdown106", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Receipts and the cash drawer", "key": "md_receipts_and_the_cash_drawer", "id": "receipts-and-the-cash-drawer", "name": "md_receipts_and_the_cash_drawer", "value": "# Receipts and the cash drawer

With a receipt printer set in the POS Profile, the receipt prints after payment and the drawer opens for cash payments. **Print bill** prints the pre-check with suggested tips. Opening the drawer without a sale is a role permission and is logged.
"}}]}]
